title: Item Client Resources
description: Defines resource pack rendering resources for an item (materials, textures, geometry, and animations), keyed by an identifier.

identifier.title: Id
identifier.description: A targeted identifier this visual/audio description uses.

materials.description: A list of identified models that this item uses.

textures.title: Textures
textures.description: A list of identified textures that this item uses.

geometry.title: Geometry model
geometry.description: A list of identified models that this item uses.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: A list of identified animation that this item uses.
